changelog: - **A loop that balances at one size of run now runs at every scale.** When a group the engine plans together takes from a full Pool exactly what it gives back, it fits at only one size of run, its largest. Where that size was not exactly representable as a computer number (for example every amount scaled to 0.01 or 0.000001 of the usual), the engine found no size that fits and the group did nothing. The engine now tries that largest size exactly first, and the group runs. A group that really does not fit still does not run. Models at ordinary sizes and the bundled examples run as before. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 21).
